# Arperture

> Arperture is a Leesburg, Virginia studio that helps local small businesses put AI to work — hands-on AI consulting, AI fluency training for teams, and Web Visibility audits (SEO, GEO & AEO) that show whether Google and ChatGPT recommend your business. Arperture also produces cinematic AI video: film-grade video, sound design, and branded stories. Founded by Andrew Dallons. Contact: contact@arperture.io · (571) 200-1186.

## Small Business Services

- [AI Consulting](https://arperture.io/small-business/#consulting): AI Business Analysis (from $497) maps which AI tools fit your operations and how to implement them; AI Implementation Consulting is an ongoing monthly retainer for workflow builds, team training, and automation.
- [AI Fluency Training](https://arperture.io/small-business/#fluency): Hands-on workshops and 1:1 sessions that make your team confident with AI — built on the tools you already use and the work you actually do. Half-day workshops to multi-session curricula.
- [Web Visibility Audit](https://arperture.io/small-business/#visibility): $750 flat, 5 business days. A 100-point scored report across SEO, GEO & AEO showing whether Google, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and AI Overviews recommend your business, with a prioritized fix roadmap.
- [All small business services](https://arperture.io/small-business/)

## Video Production

- [AI Video Services & Production](https://arperture.io/services/): Concept-to-completion cinematic AI video — film direction, creative direction, sound & score — via a 14-step pipeline.
- [Image & Video Enhancement, Restoration & Colorization](https://arperture.io/enhancement/): Studio-grade upscaling, damage repair, and black-and-white colorization for photos and video, priced by tier and quoted up front.

## Work

- [Portfolio](https://arperture.io/portfolio/): AI-directed films, music videos, and branded content.
- [Yield Bookkeeping Services (case study)](https://arperture.io/portfolio/yield/): A full AI-powered brand video campaign.
- [Judge Silverback's Court (case study)](https://arperture.io/portfolio/judge/): An AI-produced courtroom comedy web series.

## Writing

- [Blog](https://arperture.io/blog/): Notes on putting AI to work in small businesses, plus AI filmmaking craft, technique, and process.
- [The 159.8% ROI Number: Why Small AI Projects Are Beating the Giants in 2026](https://arperture.io/blog/why-small-ai-projects-are-beating-the-giants/): The data on small-budget AI ROI, training investment, and human-in-the-loop systems for small businesses.
- [Claude vs. ChatGPT vs. Gemini: A Plain-English Guide for Small Business Owners](https://arperture.io/blog/claude-vs-chatgpt-vs-gemini-for-small-business/): What each AI assistant is best at in 2026 and a practical four-step way to pick the right one.
- [FAQ](https://arperture.io/faq/): Common questions on AI services, fluency training, video cost, timelines, and ownership.
